mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions and a comfortable 70 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park. Additionally, look up this evening at 5:46 PM to catch the International Space Station as it travels from the west over Mount Horeb toward the northeast near Madison, peaking about halfway up the sky.

The Public Works Department is continuing its year-round maintenance on streets and utilities, and you can keep up with all the latest city news and programs by subscribing to the official digital city newsletter.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with trivia nights happening today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, followed by live music at Paddy Mac's and yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In the weekly report, on November 4, a crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue led to an arrest for O W I involving a driver with a passenger under 16 years old.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Turtle. Culver's is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a scoop.
